statusDefinitions.pending: Received as an intake candidate but not eligible for training.
statusDefinitions.blocked: Cannot enter the training corpus until the missing authorization or review is resolved.
statusDefinitions.approved: All required rights, provenance, privacy, safety, quality, deduplication and legal review evidence is present; eligible for explicit promotion.
statusDefinitions.rejected: Must not be ingested into the production training corpus.

intake.licenseOrAgreement: CC0 1.0 for structured data in the main, Property, Lexeme and EntitySchema namespaces
intake.acquisitionRoute: official Wikidata dump or documented supported data-access method; do not use an unbounded live scrape
intake.notes: International knowledge-graph intake only. No source bytes have been acquired or promoted by this record. The graph should feed a Fresh-owned knowledge layer with entity IDs, aliases, multilingual labels, relationships, references, temporal qualifiers and provenance rather than being treated as unquestioned truth.

note: External sources remain blocked from production training until all required evidence and reviews are complete. The internally authored synthetic corpus remains pipeline-validation data only.
